binding: Verdict is bound to the exact image SHA-256 values below; repository HEAD is context only and does not prove the captures depict committed code.

method.scope: Visual inspection of four supplied reference captures and five supplied output captures. No behavior, animation, or performance verification. Full-room composition compared with full-room reference; mechanism closeup compared with safe/workbench closeups. Supporting avatar reference assessed for authored form and integration, not photorealism.

verdict: DOES NOT MEET THE FIXED VISUAL BAR
strengths: Coherent dark green, wood, and brass direction; central vault is an obvious focal point.
Useful desktop objective, lock count, collected-tools area, inspection state, and completion state.
Modeled rings, pins, balance scales, books, wall trim, and robot accessories establish a concrete 3D scene.

biggest_remaining_gap.title: Focal objects lack the authored shape and material richness of the primary reference
biggest_remaining_gap.evidence: mechanism.png is dominated by smooth concentric rings, rods, a flat black center, broad trim, and coarse repeated wear. room4-safe-mechanism.jpg and room4-workbench-mechanism.jpg expose layered housings, toothed and linked components, fasteners, fine surface variation, and a visibly built mechanism. This is apparent at matched closeup purpose, not a consequence of comparing image resolutions.
biggest_remaining_gap.target: Develop the final vault into one finished hero assembly: layered recessed plates and housings, visibly connected gears/latches and pivots, beveled profiles, engraved dial markings, purposeful fasteners, and differentiated brass/iron surface response. Preserve readability. Re-capture the current closeup and room view; the new structure and material separation must remain visible at both scales.

blockers.evidence: room.png: paired shelves and blocklike books repeat almost exactly; four similar pedestals form a row; desk and floor occupy large, lightly detailed areas. Limited contact-shadow definition and broad illumination flatten object separation.
blockers.target: Finish focal desk/vault surroundings with a few distinctly modeled narrative props, varied book groupings and shelf silhouettes, richer joinery, and stronger local contact shading; establish one dominant light hierarchy.

blockers.evidence: mechanism.png: the ring assembly reads clearly, but wide black voids, smooth rods, broad arch surfaces, and sparse diagram board dominate. Metal wear is coarse relative to the object scale.
blockers.target: Complete the hero-assembly target above before adding more generic room props. Match visible finish density to the supplied safe/workbench frames.

blockers.evidence: character.png contains floor, furniture and mechanisms but no visible character. room.png provides only a small side view of a robot built from a round head, rounded torso, thin limbs and accessory bundle.
blockers.target: After the known framing fix, provide an unobscured three-quarter full-body view occupying roughly 40–60% of the 3D viewport height, with feet and contact shadow visible. The next art target beyond clipping is a deliberately authored robot silhouette: articulated hands/feet and limb joints, stronger face/eye identity, layered body panels, distinct material response and a purposeful pose. A robot is a valid style choice; human realism is not required.
blockers.acceptance: Character completion cannot be approved from this evidence; animation and interaction are unverified.

blockers.evidence: result.png clearly shows 8/8 and Escape confirmed, but the open doorway reveals a flat pale area, and thin reddish horizontal lines cross the room without a clear visual explanation.
blockers.target: Give the revealed exit depth and a legible destination/light treatment; resolve or explain the crossing lines through intentional styling, and compose a clear final world state.

blockers.evidence: mobile.png is 390×844; the actual rendered room occupies only about 255 px vertically, surrounded by large dark bands inside the scene card. Vault/character details are tiny, and the helper still says ESC.
blockers.target: Use a portrait camera/layout so the actual room receives about 400 px or more of visible height at this viewport; collapse secondary narration as needed, retain clear object focus, and provide a touch-appropriate back hint. Re-capture both room and mechanism inspection on mobile.

blockers.evidence: The desktop hierarchy and completion status are readable, but the sidebar and overlays consume substantial space during inspection; the result list repeats generic Balance Clue and Tool Dependency labels.
blockers.target: Allow a compact inspection layout and use distinguishing lock/tool names or thumbnails. Static screenshots do not establish control usability.

next_review_required: Same full-room and mechanism angles after the hero assembly finish pass.
Unobscured character full-body view and one visible interaction state.
Mobile room and focused mechanism with reduced unused vertical space.
Final exit reveal with clear spatial depth.
